summary: Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. (SVAQ), a Cayman-domiciled Nasdaq SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a third amendment to its June 17, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with EigenQ, Inc., a Delaware software company. The September 26, 2026 amendment excludes certain EigenQ warrants from definitions and calculations and clarifies each such warrant converts into one PubCo warrant at closing. The deal structure involves SVAQ redomiciling to Delaware via domestication, then Merger Sub merging into EigenQ, which survives as a wholly owned subsidiary. No price, premium or closing date was restated; watch warrant overhang and redemption dynamics ahead of closing.
